## Technical Architecture of NEXUS 01
- Custom 8K Canvas2D & Kirigami Pipeline: client-side edge-directed sharpening, alpha defringing, stepped cotton-rag paper surface quantization, cream die-cut contour silhouettes, and physical 3D shadow casting.
- 36-frame scroll-locked gait kinematics & 8-beat camera choreography without external 3D/WebGL dependencies.
- Procedural WebAudio synthesizer (footsteps, truck approach/horn/impact FX, cathedral harmonic chords, mercury pour & awakening swell) synchronized with Japanese SpeechSynthesis turn-locked dialogues.
- Full SSR semantic HTML parity for all 5 case files and 8 skill nodes, JSON-LD @graph, JSON Resume v1.0, ATS print mode (@media print), and Lighthouse 100/100/100/100 across Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO, and Agentic Browsing (Desktop & Mobile).
